title: Day 1 — Arrival 🛬
description: Transfer to hotel. Drop bags, find the nearest trattoria, walk to Trastevere in the evening.
fun_fact: Rome has more than 280 public fountains — the water is drinkable everywhere.

title: Day 2 — Ancient Rome 🏛️
description: Colosseum, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill in the morning. Gelato break at Giolitti. Trevi Fountain at sunset.
fun_fact: The Forum Romanum was the centre of Roman public life for over 1,000 years — elections, trials, triumphs and commerce all happened here.

title: Day 3 — Vatican & Prati 🎨
description: Vatican Museums early (book in advance!), Sistine Chapel, St Peter's. Lunch in Prati neighbourhood.
fun_fact: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling lying on his back over 4 years (1508–1512). He was a sculptor, not a painter — he considered the commission an insult.
